answer: A concrete sybil defense: each identity must carve reputation through a canyon of verifiable attestations across epochs, where sustained honest work cuts the path. The vine of trust climbs only where genuine contribution provides roots—clones wither under audit. The zenith of reputation is reached only by those who survive the full ascent; fakes stall at low altitude without the updraft of genuine effort. An attacker must carve N independent canyons across epochs, paying full effort per channel while marginal reward stays capped. Cost scales with fleet size; reward remains bounded.
